messages:
jamie: Heads-up: planned release window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC for API/runtime/console/router. Primary goal: enable routing v2 + runtime kernel update + console schema change. Please ack if you have blockers. :calendar:

maria: Ack. runtime will land kernel selector + kv-cache eviction tweak. Will need a short warmup after cutover. ETA ~10m of elevated tokens.

jon: Ack. API has a client-contract change (minor) and a pinned model-version bump (redwood/model-neo-1.2.0 -> redwood/model-neo-1.3.0). Will coordinate rollout.

tara: Ack. Console schema change is additive but we need a live migration for route metadata -> will run migration job during the window. Migration id: mig_route_meta_2026_03_20.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job #DPL-8745 starting 2619877200 (02:00 UTC). Services: api-service, runtime-service, console-service, router-service. Canary config: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m pauses. Operators: jamie, maria, jon, tara, sachin.

jamie: Quick checklist before DPL kicks: 1) Pin API -> 1.3.0, 2) Runtime kernel flag on staging, 3) Console migration queued, 4) Router feature flag ready. Who takes each?

maria: I'll take runtime kernel flag + warmup plan. Command I'll run on staging/prod after canary: ```sh
redwood runtime set-kernel --service runtime-service --kernel kernel-v2
redwood runtime warmup --service runtime-service --workers 10 --duration 120s
```

jon: I'll handle API pin and model fallback rules. Pin command: ```sh
redwood api pin-model --service api-service --model redwood/model-neo:1.3.0
redwood api set-fallback --service api-service --model redwood/model-neo:1.2.0 --threshold 5%
```

tara: I'll run the console migration job at canary->25% transition. Migration command: ```sh
run-migration mig_route_meta_2026_03_20 --target console-db --batch-size 500 --dry-run=false
```

jamie: Router (sachin) will flip routing-v2 flag after first 5% canary is stable. We need a meeting point if errors >5% or latency >200ms p50 on any route. Rollback plan?

sachin: On it. Router rollback is feature-flag reversal + graceful draining. Commands: ```sh
router feature-toggle set routing-v2 false --env prod
router drain --service router-service --grace 60s
```

maria: Runtime rollback if kernel-v2 causes token regression: revert to kernel-v1 and flush kv-cache: ```sh
redwood runtime set-kernel --service runtime-service --kernel kernel-v1
redwood runtime kv-cache flush --service runtime-service --scope prefix:session
```

jon: API rollback = unpin to 1.2.0 + increase fallback freq: ```sh
redwood api pin-model --service api-service --model redwood/model-neo:1.2.0
redwood api set-fallback --service api-service --threshold 0%
```

jamie: OK good. Addendum: if console migration fails we will pause traffic and run a hotfix migration script from staging snapshot. Tara, ensure snapshot exists and tested.

tara: Snapshot exists: console-db-snap-2619876000, tested on staging. I'll keep the script ready.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% started at 2619877300. Observability hooks: per-route latency dashboard + per-model token-cost panel. Alerts: #ops-alerts and paged to oncall.

jon: Seeing slight increase in tail-latency on model 1.3.0 (p99 +70ms). Not alarming yet. Monitoring.

maria: Runtime kernel telemetry shows increased GPU memcpy at step 3 - watching. Warmup still running.

jamie: If we hit any of the abort criteria (error rate >3% sustained 2min, latency p95 >250ms, migration failure), we stop canary and start rollback checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary pause triggered at 2619877480: error rate on api-service 3.4% over 2m. Pausing rollout at 5%.

jon: I'm rolling back API model pin to 1.2.0 now. Running command.

jon: Done. Pin reverted. Monitoring error rate.

maria: Reverted too? Runtime warmup still in progress but kernel flag check shows no kernel-v2 assignment for majority (good).

deploy-bot: Rollback steps executed for api-service. Canary aborted. System traffic back to baseline.

jamie: Postmortem plan: collect traces + evals for the 5% sample, run model quality diff between 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 on the failing prompts. Assignments: jon -> model diff + rollback rationale, maria -> kernel telemetry + warmup tweaks, tara -> ensure migration stayed idle, sachin -> router flag stayed off. I'll draft release note update and a follow-up patch window.

sachin: Router never flipped. Confirmed.

tara: Migration was not started. Snapshot preserved.

jon: Uploading model diffs to the release doc now: https://redwood.internal/releases/DPL-8745/postmortem (link).

jamie: Thanks all. We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 UTC to plan reattempt after triage. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — will post telemetry summary before the sync.

deploy-bot: Deployment job DPL-8745 marked aborted at 2619877600.

jamie: closing thread - will move notes to the release board.
